verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
My soul longs and even faints for You
My heart and my flesh cries out for the living God
For the living God

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Incline your ear with trembling and tears
I'm yearning
To the throne of grace, to seek Your face
I'm burning, longing for You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I need You, I need You
Nothing, no place, no one else will do
I need You, I need You
For You satisfy the longing inside
